content_fields.title: Follow best practices when handling access tokens (API tokens)
content_fields.description: Add issuer, audience, issued-at and identifier claims, shorten the lifetime and support revocation.
content_fields.finding: Access tokens are minted with only an exp claim — no issuer, audience, jti or revocation support — and the caller chooses the lifetime.
criteria: Tokens carry iss, aud, iat, exp and jti, and the verifier checks all of them.
Access token lifetime is short and refresh is a separate, revocable credential.
